name: Towers
bio: Towers was a cattleman who came to town with Boice in March 1884 to arrange the April round-up meeting at Little Missouri, and in 1885 proposed a Wyoming association resolution barring horse racing on members' ranches. In April 1886 he attended the Little Missouri stockgrowers' meeting as one of the members from Mingusville.
